description: Secure chat tool for faculty, students and staff with enterprise data protections; approved for Public, Internal and Confidential data (not Restricted). Course permission is set separately.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (Basic)A secure, AI‑powered chat tool for work and education that allows users to ask questions, explore ideas, and draft content in a conversational format. Copilot Chat is grounded in web information by default and, when permitted, can also reference files or content you provide. It is designed for general tasks such as researching topics, summarizing documents, and brainstorming, while maintaining enterprise data protections.
